title: In mortal state even prayers displease; lighter daily faults do not cast out gospel acceptance
source_text: XLVIII. Praeterea durante hoc statu non solum Deo displicent peccata a renatis commissa; sed etiam eorum obedientia, orationes, & gratiarum actiones. Imo nihil ab iis procedere potest quod pro tunc Deo gratum & acceptum sit. Illo vero favore atque complacentia qua Deo grati atque accepti sunt qui incedunt non secundum car-nem, sed secundum spiritum, non excidunt fideles propter leviora peccata, in quae quo-tidie incurrunt. Ac quamvis ea in se, non solum Deo displiceant; sed etiam merito efficere possint, ut universa nostra obedientia foeda sit in oculis Domini, eique peni-tus displiceat, Deus tamen iis non obstantibus, imperfectam nostram obedientiam in Christo acceptat, & oculos suos ab ei adhaerescentibus naevis quasi avertens, synceri-tatem & humilitatem ejusdem gratiose intuetur, & ex iis complacentiam & oblectatio-nem capit.
pass_a_gloss: Moreover while this state lasts not only do the sins committed by the regenerate displease God; but also their obedience, prayers, and thanksgivings. Nay nothing can proceed from them which for the time is pleasing and acceptable to God. But that favor and complacency by which those are pleasing and acceptable to God who walk not according to the flesh but according to the Spirit, the faithful do not forfeit on account of the lighter sins into which they daily run. And although those in themselves not only displease God but can even deservedly bring it about that our whole obedience be foul in the Lord’s eyes and utterly displease him, yet God, those things not withstanding, accepts our imperfect obedience in Christ, and as it were turning his eyes from the blemishes clinging to it, graciously regards its sincerity and humility, and takes complacency and delight from them.
pass_b_english: During a mortal fall even regenerate prayers and thanks are unacceptable for the time.
Daily lighter faults do not cast out Spirit-walk acceptance: God in Christ receives imperfect obedience, eyes off its clinging blemishes.

choices.why: Mercy receives imperfect obedience despite lighter faults.
